I answered Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**, their Director of Yard Operations.

- **Where it came from:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the account's main contact. Marcus is in #north-team, so he can see both. A contact name is an account detail, not a money figure, so it was fine to post in the channel.
- **gbrain still doesn't work:** it refused the search for the same reason as before (`requester_scope_required`), so I used the channel and the public file directly. Whoever runs the brain server still needs to bind the token with `gbrain auth rescope --token *** --member <member>`, or `--may-act-for <members>` so this shared bot can act for several people.
